selection: Dev only, single explicit count plus corresponding clear unit, matching one tracked changed billing slot. Fixed seeded shuffle, 4 demonstrations containing 6 distinct human exchanges, two single-update and two two-update examples covering three guest and three stay edits; unique dev dialogue per turn and no no-op. Synthetic tariff uses same price convention as the main benchmark. No validation or test accuracy used to choose examples.
protocol: Fixed four answered demonstration conversations followed by original query, same complete prefix history, 16-token greedy generation, thinking disabled, no logit mask, strict whole-number scoring cloned from P1-1, batch size 1, bf16, unchanged original 192 cases. Only demonstration messages are added to the original model input. Output prompt and answers archived in demos.json; full test prompt constructed by original prompt(desc,history) in P1-1/run.py.
